ODA_FOOD_ENABLED=true default routes food/drinks via live Oda; false retains existing fixture demo. Original purchase proposal remains null. RequestStatus adds checkout_ready; Interpretation adds grocery. UI one-line additions needed in OfficeTwin/TwinDevicePanel status label maps (root applying only those enum labels). New isolated OdaFoodOrder component and connection card mounted in App. Exact snapshot approval required before additive manipulate_cart; rechecks stock/price, persists attempts, uncertain outcome reconciles read-only, never retries delta. cart_ready != ordered; checkout/payment on Oda, no orders row.
